title: Omnivoice launches free AI voice cloning from 3 seconds of #omnivoice #voicecloning #aitechnology
description: Omnivoice launches a free, open-source voice cloning tool that replicates any voice from just 3 seconds of audio. It captures tone, rhythm, and natural emotions, enabling users to generate speech, stories, and full conversations in nearly 500 languages. The platform offers fine-tuning controls for gender, age, accent, pitch, and emotion, enhancing customization. It includes a built-in MCP server for easy integration with coding agents like Claude Code, appealing to developers and creators seeking versatile voice synthesis solutions. Omnivoice represents a significant step in accessible voice cloning technology, providing powerful capabilities without cost or proprietary restrictions, accelerating innovation in speech AI and multilingual applications. #Omnivoice #VoiceCloning #OpenSourceAI #SpeechSynthesis #AI #ClaudeCode #VoiceAI #MultilingualAI #VoiceGeneration #MCPServer #TechInnovation #ArtificialIntelligence #VoiceTech #FreeAI #SpeechAI
